page.layout: One blank page of paper; no printed blocks. Stains, foxing and a dark edge at the left and right margins; a digitiser's grey corner patch at the lower right.
page.notes: The scan shows a blank leaf with no printed text, no page number, no running head, no catchword and no signature. The darker patches at the left edge and the lower-right corner are paper damage, staining and the digitiser's cover sheet, not print. Show-through is not legible as text.
